summary: First-iteration end-to-end test of Nice2Meechu MVP. Backend: 24/24 pytest cases pass covering auth/OTP, profile, onboarding, location, video, samples, feed, swipe/match, messages and translate (EN->ES verified live via Emergent LLM). Frontend: Full happy path verified (splash -> phone -> OTP dev autofill -> 3-step onboarding -> video sample pick -> vertical feed with codename/distance/vibe badges -> Like -> Match celebration with reveal -> Say hi -> Chat with demo reply -> Matches list -> Profile -> bottom nav). One UI/integration bug found: the chat send button is overlapped by the 'Made with Emergent' anchor badge in the mobile viewport (480x900), so the on-screen button click is intercepted. Enter-key send works.

ui_bugs.issue:
The #emergent-badge anchor (bottom-right of the viewport) overlaps the chat-send-button at 480x900. document.elementFromPoint(center) on the send button returns the badge's

, so taps in that area do not reach the button. Workaround in app today is the Enter key on the input (works).

action_items: Lift chat input row above the Emergent badge: either raise the chat input bar's z-index (e.g. z-50) and add bottom padding so the badge doesn't sit over the send button, OR reserve right-side space (e.g. pr-28 on the input row) so the send button is to the left of the badge zone.
critical_code_review_comments: VideoPick.save() in mode='record' uses URL.createObjectURL(blob) and stores the blob URL on the user via /api/users/video. Blob URLs are per-document and won't load for other users or after reload. Recorded videos need real upload/storage to be reusable in the feed. Currently fine because sample-pick is the default tested path.
DEV_OTP_STORE is an in-memory dict; OTP state is lost on backend restart (acceptable for DEV mock but worth noting).
send_message has no rate-limit / length validation on text (accepts any size).
haversine_km returns 999.0 if any coord is None, which renders 'near you' in the UI; acceptable but logic could be made explicit.
test_credentials: DEV OTP mock mode. Any E.164 phone; dev_code is returned by /api/auth/send-otp and surfaced in the OTP screen's 'DEV autofill' button.
seed_data_creation: Six demo users (luna/kai/rumi/sol/indie/noa) auto-seed on first /api/feed call. ~70% auto-match probability on like to exercise the match flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file is at /app/backend/tests/test_n2m_backend.py and is fully green. Frontend happy path is fully working; only blocker to confirm next is that the chat send button is reachable to user taps after the badge overlap fix. Use viewport 480x900 (matches app .n2m-phone shell).
rca of the issue:
The Emergent preview badge () is injected as a fixed-position element at the bottom of the page. The chat input row sits at viewport bottom inside .n2m-phone with no extra right padding. At 480-wide viewport, the badge (right:286-464,bottom:844-884) covers the send button (left:416-468,top:830-878). Even with Playwright force=True the synthetic click is dispatched to the topmost element at that point (the badge's

), so React's onClick never fires. Mitigation: raise the input row's stacking context above the badge or pad it so the button is to the left of the badge zone.
